metadata.case_name: MOHAMMED SAYEED v. LEIGHTON ROAD HOTEL MANAGEMENT SERVICES LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: senior chef in the food and beverages section of their hotel  Crowne Plaza Hong Kong

injuries.description: Cut wound over left ring finger tip with resulting pain, stiffness, weakness, numbness and hypersensitivity and residual flexion stiffness/contractures
source: Physical examination revealed a 1 cm cut wound over the plaintiffs left ring finger tip.
In the Form 9, his injury was assessed by the Board as "left ring finger cut resulting in (i) pain, stiffness, weakness, numbness and hypersensitivity; and (ii) psychiatric impairment".

Clinically, there is flexion stiffness at left middle, ring and little finger. The palmer skin of his left middle, ring and little fingers is dry. X-rays showed osteopaenia (reduced bone density) around the proximal interphanlangeal joints and metacarpophalangeal joints of the left ring and middle fingers. The cut wound at the left ring finger tip had healed. However, there is persistent hypersensitivity and tenderness along the left ring finger.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of finger or thumb

injuries.description: Psychiatric impairment diagnosed as mild depressive episode
source: Attended Psychiatric Outpatient Clinic, Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital ("PYNEH") on 18 July 2012. In that interview, he complained of depressed mood, poor sleep, poor appetite, limited motivation in daily routine, feeling uselessness, anxiety symptoms like chest discomfort, hand tremor and headache. Diagnosis was mild depressive episode.
In the Form 9, his injury was assessed by the Board as "left ring finger cut resulting in (i) pain, stiffness, weakness, numbness and hypersensitivity; and (ii) psychiatric impairment".

manifestations.description: persistent pain in his left ring finger
stiffness of the left ring finger
hypersensitivity along the left ring finger
flexion stiffness / flexion contractures at left middle, ring and little fingers
palmar skin dryness of left middle, ring and little fingers
osteopaenia around the proximal interphalangeal joints and metacarpophalangeal joints of the left ring and middle fingers (reduced bone density on x-ray)
limited range of motion of left ring finger
diffuse pain over his left ring finger and whole left upper limb
limited motivation in daily routine / feeling of uselessness
anxiety symptoms including chest discomfort, hand tremor and headache

source: His cut wound was sutured and he was prescribed by painkiller.
His cut wound was sutured and he was prescribed by painkiller.
At RTSKH, the doctors working diagnosis of the plaintiffs medical condition was complex regional pain syndrome for which he was referred to pain clinic for further treatment.
He also received occupational therapy and physiotherapy for treating such syndrome as preliminarily diagnosed.
As for his left ring finger injury, it was treated with physiotherapy and medication.
Attended Psychiatric Outpatient Clinic, Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital ("PYNEH") on 18 July 2012.
He was prescribed with medication for his psychiatric condition.

losses.description: Unable or would have difficulty to return to his previous work as a chef when both hands are needed; unable to resume pre-accident chefs duties
